d:
Git gate hue jina aur git gate hue hi jivan ki antim sans ko vidaee dena — yahi to hai aadivasi sabhyata, jiski khubsurti itni gahri hai ki use keval mahsus kiya ja sakta hai. aadivasiyon ne git gate-gate janglon ko sanvara hai aur apni paranpraon ko sajiv rakha hai.
Yah git ranchi ke getalsud kshetr ke ek aadivasi kalakar dvara gaya ja raha hai — din bhar ki mehnat ke bad bhi jismen jivan ka ullas bahta hai. yahi hai jharkhand ka jadu...
